external_resource_dependencies.use: browser-local word-token and word-type frequency-profile coverage
browser-local selectable first-1000, first-2000, or full NGSL ranked-list coverage
complete take in#v candidate-sense projection for browser-local human review and fixtures

scope.claims: explicitly selected TUBELEX frequency-profile, NGSL ranked-list, or researcher-supplied Nation BNC/COCA word-family coverage; separate OEWN multiword-verb form membership; transparent user-pattern candidates; and human occurrence/idiomaticity/target-sense review

reference_profiles.separation_rule: the selected word frequency or ranked-list profile and confirmed-MWE lexicon membership use named resources, units, denominators, and outputs and are never averaged or substituted

word.selection_rule: the researcher explicitly selects one profile and the applicable NGSL head-rank or Nation BNC/COCA word-family-level cutoff before analysis

local_import.delivery_rule: researcher generates and imports the exact profile locally; neither source nor generated profile is bundled, transmitted, or retained by the app
local_import.special_list_rule: basewrd31 proper nouns, basewrd32 marginal words, basewrd33 transparent compounds, and basewrd34 acronyms are excluded

word.input_unit: NFKC-normalized ASCII alphabetic surface token; apostrophes and hyphens are boundaries
word.boundary: TUBELEX is a YouTube subtitle exposure approximation; NGSL is ranked-list membership; BNC/COCA is Level 6 receptive word-family membership with special lists excluded. None establishes contextual meaning, learner knowledge, CEFR, MWE knowledge, or a universal comprehension threshold

mwe_form.input_unit: researcher-confirmed occurrence with an exact normalized canonical form
mwe_form.boundary: lexicographic membership; not occurrence truth, PARSEME category, corpus frequency, contextual sense, or pedagogical importance

mwe_sense.input_unit: researcher-confirmed take in occurrence with full local context
denominators: confirmed occurrences with an admitted candidate-sense projection
mwe_sense.boundary: complete OEWN candidate set for take in#v only; human assignment, ambiguity, and abstention are separate from inventory membership, sense frequency, and learner knowledge

candidate_generation.method: ordered case-insensitive surface-member alternatives supplied as four-column TSV
candidate_generation.boundary: pattern matches are candidates only; human confirmation or rejection and a decision note are required for terminal occurrence status
candidate_generation.starter_pattern_scope: two project-authored function examples only; not comprehensive, frequency-ranked, pedagogically ranked, or an admitted MWE reference inventory

token_record.id: unique within one document and stable for that exact tokenization
token_record.normalized: output of the metric contract tokenizer for the same token position

occurrence_record.member_rule: two or more unique token IDs in document order
occurrence_record.gap_rule: every non-member token strictly between the first and last member; a gap may contain a pronoun or full noun-phrase object and is not an MWE member
occurrence_record.overlap_rule: a token may belong to multiple occurrences; confirmed member density counts the union once
occurrence_record.decision_rule: confirmed and rejected occurrences require provenance and a note; unresolved candidates have no terminal decision
occurrence_record.inventory_identity_rule: matched or out_of_inventory requires both inventory ID and version; not_attempted or inventory_ineligible requires both to be null
occurrence_record.form_sense_count_rule: an optional matched-profile sense_count describes inventory entries only and never assigns a contextual sense
idiomaticity_rules: idiomaticity is separate from structural category, occurrence status, and fine-grained sense
idiomatic, literal, and ambiguous decisions require project provenance
an unresolved candidate is always not_assessed
sense_rules: confirmed occurrences always carry explicit form and sense records
not_attempted and inventory_ineligible lookup carry no invented inventory identity
a matched candidate list contains the complete admitted sense projection for that form and part of speech
assigned selects exactly one candidate sense
multiple_assigned selects at least two senses that jointly apply in context
ambiguous preserves at least two named alternatives because the context does not resolve among them
abstained requires matched candidates but selects no sense
unassigned, abstained, out_of_inventory, and inventory_ineligible select no sense
out_of_inventory requires a complete permitted search and may follow either a zero-candidate lookup or review of an inadequate matched candidate set
inventory_ineligible means the confirmed type is outside the declared inventory scope; it is not a semantic miss

assigned, multiple_assigned, ambiguous, abstained, out_of_inventory, and inventory_ineligible states require decision provenance; an inventory supplies candidates but does not validate contextual assignment
rejected and unresolved candidate occurrences carry no inventory or sense result

workspace_file.scope: one MWE review document; not a publication export
workspace_file.restore_rule: require current authorization attestation plus exact source-text SHA-256, contract, word-profile selection, and runtime-resource identities before restoring
workspace_file.retention_rule: explicit user download only; no browser storage, upload, autosave, or server copy

document_set_file.scope: one named set of independently reviewed MWE documents; no pooling, collaboration, or publication export
document_set_file.restore_rule: validate every embedded workspace and source-text SHA-256 before replacing the current in-memory set
document_set_file.retention_rule: explicit user download only; no browser storage, upload, autosave, server copy, pooling, or inference

measurement.word_token_coverage: selected-profile-tokenized input tokens meeting the declared frequency-membership or ranked-list cutoff rule divided by all tokens from that profile-specific tokenizer
measurement.word_type_coverage: distinct selected-profile-tokenized input forms meeting the declared rule divided by all distinct forms from that profile-specific tokenizer
measurement.word_ranked_list_status: for NGSL or the local Nation BNC/COCA profile, matched is at or below the selected cutoff, beyond_cutoff is source-listed above it, and unmatched is absent from the projection; ambiguous head mappings remain visible where present
measurement.confirmed_member_density: union of confirmed member token IDs divided by all word tokens; gap tokens are excluded
measurement.occurrence_annotation_coverage: confirmed plus rejected occurrences divided by all candidate occurrences
measurement.idiomaticity_annotation_coverage: idiomatic, literal, or ambiguous decisions divided by all candidate occurrences
measurement.form_inventory_coverage: confirmed occurrences with a matched form divided by confirmed occurrences
measurement.form_inventory_type_coverage: distinct confirmed canonical forms with a matched form divided by all distinct confirmed canonical forms
measurement.sense_inventory_coverage: confirmed occurrences with matched sense candidates divided by confirmed occurrences
measurement.sense_assignment_coverage: assigned or multiple_assigned occurrences divided by confirmed occurrences with matched sense candidates
measurement.zero_denominator: ratio value is null and numerator and denominator remain visible
